name: task-runner
description: Persistent knowledge-graph memory and a task runner for your agent. Local SQLite, MCP tools, a session-start briefing, a live side panel and memory reminders.

nudge.title: Remind the agent to save memory
nudge.description: After a turn that edits many files or commits without saving anything to memory, add a one-line reminder to your next prompt.

toasts.title: Show a toast when memory changes
toasts.description: Show what the agent remembers, links or forgets, so you can catch bad memory early.

band.title: Show task progress above the prompt
band.description: While a task group has open tasks, show a one-line progress bar above the prompt.

commitNotes.title: Record commits in memory
commitNotes.description: After each git commit the agent makes, save a short change note (hash, subject, size) to project memory. No model call is involved.

approve.title: Skip permission prompts for the memory tools
approve.description: Approve this plugin's own memory and task tools automatically. They only touch the local memory database. clear_tasks still asks.
